I added the `flagged` subcommand to `skills/planning/critic/scripts/critic_ledger.py`. I ran it on five inputs and each behaved as specified.

It reuses the script's existing `_load_json`, which already strips a Markdown code fence, so unreadable files and invalid JSON give `PARSE_ERROR:`. A new `validate_flagged` function does the shape check and gives `FLAGGED_DECISIONS_PARSE_ERROR:`. Both exit 1 with a single line on stderr. I also added the usage line to the module docstring.

The five inputs, all run by hand (I added no test files):
- A fenced `json` array with both keys printed the array and exited 0.
- A JSON object instead of an array gave `FLAGGED_DECISIONS_PARSE_ERROR: expected a JSON array`.
- An item missing `why_flagged` gave `FLAGGED_DECISIONS_PARSE_ERROR: item 0 needs both decision and why_flagged`.
- A file with invalid JSON gave `PARSE_ERROR:`.
- A missing file gave `PARSE_ERROR:`.

`SKILL.md` already calls `critic_ledger.py flagged "$tmp"`, so I didn't change it.
